### **Transcription**

**[Entry 1: 1867]**

> **- In Mense Julii -**

**[Entry 2: 1868]**

### **Translation / Key Details**

For your genealogical records, these entries follow a standard Latin formula used by Catholic parish priests at the time: **"Die [Date] [Groom] et [Bride]. Coram [Witness 1] et [Witness 2]. [Priest Name]"** (*Coram* means "in the presence of").

* **July 22, 1867:**
* **Groom:** William Hayes (*Gulielmum*)
* **Bride:** Honora Walsh (*Honoram*)
* **Witnesses:** Patrick Walsh (*Patritio*) & Margaret O'Donnell (*Margarata O'Donnel*)
* **Officiating Priest:** John Quinlan, C.C. (*Joannes Quinlan*, Catholic Curate)


* **October 22, 1868:**
* **Groom:** John Carroll (*Joannem*)
* **Bride:** Ellen Moroney (*Ellenam*)
* **Witnesses:** Cornelius Carroll (*Cornelio*) & Mary Danaher (*Maria*)
* **Officiating Priest:** John Quinlan, C.C. (*Joannes Quinlan*)
